name: Timothar, Baron of Bats
oracle_text:
Ward—Discard a card.
Whenever another nontoken Vampire you control dies, you may pay {1} and exile it. If you do, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying. It gains "When this token deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice it and return the exiled card to the battlefield tapped."
blocked_sentences: Whenever another nontoken Vampire you control dies, you may pay {1} and exile it. If you do, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying. It gains "When this token deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice it and return the exiled card to the battlefield tapped."

needs.what: a link from the card exiled by Timothar's dies trigger to the specific token created in the same resolution, so that an ability granted to that token ("When this token deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice it and return the exiled card to the battlefield tapped") can name exactly that exiled card when it later resolves
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_ability can hand the token a deals_combat_damage_to_player trigger with sacrifice + put_onto_battlefield tapped, but the granted ability's only way to find a card in exile is the selector `exiled_with`, which keys on the ability's source (the token) rather than on Timothar or on the trigger's `as` binding; bindings from the dies trigger (`as` on exile) do not survive into a separately triggered granted ability, and exile's `link`/`until_leaves` returns the card when a permanent leaves rather than on the token's damage trigger. Each Bat must return its own card, so returning 'cards exiled with Timothar' would also be wrong
